  3. Add IKEv2 VPN policy on SonicWALL1. Select X0 subnet as local network and SonicWALL2's X0 subnet as destination network. Select 3DES-SHA1. Set Phase1 lifetime to 270 seconds and Phase2 lifetime to 180 seconds.

9.initial: PC1 --- X0 SonicWALL1 X1 -- PC2 -- X1 SonicWALL2 X0 --- PC3
9.title: Re-keying. Matched lifetime settings.
9.result: The initial tunnel is negotiated, you will see two INIT packets and two AUTH packets. After 180 seconds CREATE_CHILD_SA request packet will be sent from initiator. Responder will send CREATE_CHILD_SA  response packet. Either side can be initiator since they both have the same lifetime. This will be Phase2 (IPSec) re-key. The same will happen in another 90 seconds, when Phase1 (IKE) expires. You will see another CREATE_CHILD_SA  packet exchange. The DELETE messages will be sent following each re-key event, the old SA will be deleted.

Responder will send CREATE_CHILD_SA  response packet. In this case, since the remote has a shorter lifetime, it will always initiate re-key and send CREATE_CHILD_SA request upon IPSec and IKE lifetime expiration. The appropriate DELETE messages will be sent after IKE or IPSec renegotiation. Those DELETE requests can be sent from either side.
